verdict.rationale: Bevy has no separate scripting language. Game logic is written in plain Rust (normal structs, traits and functions), and the crate itself provides the typed API surface, documented in-depth on its reference docs and on static, crawlable docs.rs pages. That typed API is the only part of this story the evidence supports; nothing documents an official language server, and any editor completions or diagnostics would come from the general Rust toolchain, which earns no credit here. Missing for 10: an official Bevy language server or editor integration, documented completions/diagnostics/navigation for coding agents, and hands-on corroboration of agent editor tooling, which also matters because frequent breaking API changes undermine agents trained on older versions.
